title: Filipino-Style Pinakbet Stuffed German Sausages
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of Filipino pinakbet with German sausages.
instructions: Cut the German sausages in half lengthwise.
Scoop out some of the meat to make room for the pinakbet.
Fill each sausage with the pinakbet mixture.
Place the stuffed sausages on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with nutritious oil and sprinkle with Korean chili flakes (if using).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with mung bean sprouts if desired.
